content.text: {"id": "mm6522a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the MTCT rate decreased from 24.2% in 1994"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Thailand has high levels of health care coverage: 98.3% of pregnant women had at least one antenatal clinic visit in 2015"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "The MTCT rate decreased from >20% to 1.9%"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "Coverage of pregnant women tested for HIV"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "HIV prevalence among pregnant women decreased from 2% in the mid-1990s to 0.6% in 2015."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Thailand has achieved WHO targets for the elimination of MTCT"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "WHO targets for elimination of MTCT of HIV: antenatal care coverage (at least one visit) ≥95%"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Thailand has a robust national prevention of MTCT monitoring and evaluation system"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "launched the Perinatal HIV Outcome Monitoring System in 2001"}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "PHIMS collects monthly summaries from hospitals"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the MTCT rate decreased from 24.2% in 1994"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Adjusted MTCT rates during 2001–2012 were calculated to include HIV-exposed infants who were not tested"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "MTCT rates were calculated based on infant HIV DNA PCR test results reported in the National AIDS Program"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "During 2013–2015, adjusted MTCT rates were calculated using SPECTRUM version 5.4"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth", "study_design"]}
